description: Immutable, dated copies of the price catalog. The newest entry is byte-identical to ../model-prices.json, which the library embeds; older entries are never edited. firstShippedIn is recorded after a snapshot ships in a release.

snapshots.summary: Adds Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna (TE-55) to the 2026-09-12 price-history review.

Adds Claude Sonnet 5.5 (2026-09-28, $2/$0.20/$2.50/$10). Every other current rate re-verified unchanged except GPT-5 Codex, which is absent from today's OpenAI rate card. Lifecycle notes for Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Haiku 4.5, GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.4 Mini (TE-59).
Adds GPT-6.1 Sol with OpenAI-dated standard short-context pricing; every shared listing and rate remains unchanged from 2026-09-29.
Adds Claude Haiku 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon, and Gemini 3.8 Flash with prompt-size tiers and announced future Gemini tariffs (TE-62).
Re-verifies the Haiku 5.5, Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 3.8 Flash tariffs, cache rates and release dates against primary vendor pages; all numerical rates remain unchanged (TE-62 review delivery).
TE-72/73 Cost Frontier candidate snapshot, superseded before release. Contains an unconfirmed Carbon price claim.
